title: Foxit Review (2026)
intro: Foxit is evaluated here as an adjacent document / PDF productivity tool — Foxit is a PDF editor and document productivity suite (PDF Editor / PDF Editor+) with a free Reader. Published list pricing centres on ~$129.99/user/year for PDF Editor (~$10.83/mo) and ~$159.99/user/year for PDF Editor+. Trial available. Adjacent to project management — strong on document-pdf, weak on work-planning boards/Gantt as a primary job. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Foxit when document/PDF productivity is the job — as adjacent tooling beside a work OS, not instead of one.
verdict: Choose Foxit when document/PDF productivity is the job — as adjacent tooling beside a work OS, not instead of one. Compare monday/Hive for work management; Getscreen.me for remote access; WebCatalog for desktop app workspaces. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: PDF Editor is familiar desktop/cloud document software for business users — approachable for edit/convert/sign jobs.
Not a work-planning product — intentionally low so adjacent PDF tools are not ranked as monday/Hive peers.
Limited batch/document automation only — not a work OS automation engine.
Shared review/sign workflows exist; not multiplayer project collaboration.
Solid Microsoft 365 / Drive / Dropbox / SharePoint document stack connectors.
Not a PM reporting product — low by design.
Per-licence annual seats scale cleanly for document workers across orgs.
Free Reader plus ~$130/user/year Editor is a clear Adobe-alternative value story. Affiliate economics excluded.
Limited AI document assistance marketed — moderate for PDF-adjacent help, not work OS AI agents.

faq.question: Is Foxit a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Foxit is adjacent document / PDF productivity software. Compare it for PDF edit/convert/sign jobs — not as a work-OS peer on undifferentiated best ranks.

faq.question: How is Foxit priced?
faq.answer: Free Reader. PDF Editor ~$129.99/user/year (~$10.83/mo); PDF Editor+ ~$159.99/user/year. Trial available. Annual per-licence — confirm live.

faq.question: Does Foxit have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Foxit?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
